server_failure: Something on the server stopped this request. Try again; if it keeps happening, open Health to see what is wrong.

connection.host_not_found: {service}: the host name in {address} was not found. Check the address.
connection.refused: {service}: nothing answered at {address}. Check that it is running and that the port is right.
connection.timeout: {service}: no answer from {address} in time. Check the address and that this machine can reach it.
connection.not_authorised: {service}: the user name or password was refused. Check them, or turn authentication off if it accepts anonymous clients.
connection.unreachable: {service}: could not connect to {address}. Check the address and the port.
connection.unreachable_url: {service}: could not connect to {address}. Check the address, scheme and port.

delivery.not_configured_discord: {channel} is not set up yet. Enter the webhook address, then test again.
delivery.not_configured_pushover: {channel} is not set up yet. Enter the user key and API token, then test again.
delivery.not_configured_telegram: {channel} is not set up yet. Enter the bot token and chat ID, then test again.
delivery.no_answer_address: {channel} did not answer. Check the webhook address, then test again.
delivery.no_answer_network: {channel} did not answer. Check that YA-WAMF can reach the internet, then test again.
delivery.timeout: {channel} took too long to answer. Wait a moment, then test again.
delivery.refused_discord: {channel} refused the message. Check the webhook address, then test again.
delivery.refused_pushover: {channel} refused the message. Check the user key and API token, then test again.
delivery.refused_telegram: {channel} refused the message. Check the bot token and chat ID, then test again.
delivery.unexpected_reply: Something answered in place of {channel}. Check for a proxy or sign-in page between YA-WAMF and the internet, then test again.
delivery.rate_limited: {channel} is limiting messages for now. Wait a minute, then test again.
delivery.provider_error: {channel} reported a problem on its side. Wait a few minutes, then test again.
